name: fi.vettid/vettid
title: Vettid
description: Free vet appointments, clinics and prices in Finland and Norway, refreshed daily.

tools.name: list_options
tools.description: Use this when you need the valid values for the other tools: services (key and name), cities with clinics, species and the currency. Not for free times, clinics or prices themselves.

country.description: FI (Finland) or NO (Norway): whose clinics, times and prices. Without it, the country of the endpoint the server is connected by (vettid.fi: Finland, vettid.no: Norway).

lang.description: The language the user writes in: fi, sv, en or nb. The services' names in the answer and the labels of the view come in it. Without it, the country's own language (Finnish for FI, Norwegian for NO).

tools.name: search_vet_slots
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a free vet appointment (eläinlääkäriaika, veterinærtime) in Finland or Norway: one service (vaccination/rokotus, health check, neutering/kastraatio, dental, ...) in one city, optionally for one species and date. Returns the free times (date, time, clinic, price, bookingUrl) and the page of the same listing on the site. Not for emergencies, medical advice or booking: the user books with the clinic through bookingUrl.

service.description: Service key or name, e.g. vaccination, rokotus, neuter, kastraatio (see list_options).

country.description: FI (Finland) or NO (Norway): whose clinics, times and prices. Without it, the country of the endpoint the server is connected by (vettid.fi: Finland, vettid.no: Norway).

lang.description: The language the user writes in: fi, sv, en or nb. The services' names in the answer and the labels of the view come in it. Without it, the country's own language (Finnish for FI, Norwegian for NO).

city.description: City name or key, e.g. Helsinki, Tampere. Without it, the city of the user's approximate location (request _meta openai/userLocation) is used when known.

species.description: dog, cat or other (small pets). Times open to any species are always included.

date.description: Only this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: every date of the next two weeks.

sort.description: time (default, soonest first) or price (cheapest first).

tools.name: list_clinics
tools.description: Use this when the user asks which vet clinics (eläinlääkäriasemat, dyreklinikker) there are in a city in Finland or Norway: name, chain, address, their services, their price for a service and a link to the clinic's page on the site. Not for emergencies or booking; get_clinic gives one clinic's details.

city.description: City name or key. Without it, the city of the user's approximate location (request _meta openai/userLocation) is used when known.

service.description: Only clinics with this service, key or name (see list_options).

country.description: FI (Finland) or NO (Norway): whose clinics, times and prices. Without it, the country of the endpoint the server is connected by (vettid.fi: Finland, vettid.no: Norway).

lang.description: The language the user writes in: fi, sv, en or nb. The services' names in the answer and the labels of the view come in it. Without it, the country's own language (Finnish for FI, Norwegian for NO).

tools.name: get_clinic
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about one vet clinic in Finland or Norway by name: its address, phone, whether it is a 24 h emergency clinic, its services with prices and free times, and its page on the site. Not for finding clinics (list_clinics) or free times (search_vet_slots).

clinic.description: The clinic's name or part of it, e.g. "Evidensia Tammisto".

city.description: The clinic's city, when the name alone is ambiguous.

country.description: FI (Finland) or NO (Norway): whose clinics, times and prices. Without it, the country of the endpoint the server is connected by (vettid.fi: Finland, vettid.no: Norway).

lang.description: The language the user writes in: fi, sv, en or nb. The services' names in the answer and the labels of the view come in it. Without it, the country's own language (Finnish for FI, Norwegian for NO).

tools.name: search_vets
tools.description: Use this when the user describes the need in their own words rather than naming one service: a symptom or reason ("koira ontuu", "kissa oksentaa", "hampaat", "limping"), a treatment name, or a clinic's or vet's name, in Finnish, Swedish, English or Norwegian. The same search as the site's search field: it maps the text to services and returns the matching free times of the coming week across all cities (or one city), soonest or cheapest first, with booking links and the site's page of the same search. Not for medical advice or emergencies: it only finds appointments.

query.description: The user's words, as they wrote them, e.g. "koira ontuu" or "kissan hammaskivi". No names or contact details of the user.

city.description: Only this city (name or key). Without it every city; the user's approximate location (openai/userLocation) narrows it when known.

species.description: dog, cat or other. A species word in the query (koira, kissa) counts too.

date.description: Only this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: the coming week.

sort.description: time (default, soonest first) or price (cheapest first).

country.description: FI (Finland) or NO (Norway): whose clinics, times and prices. Without it, the country of the endpoint the server is connected by (vettid.fi: Finland, vettid.no: Norway).

lang.description: The language the user writes in: fi, sv, en or nb. The services' names in the answer and the labels of the view come in it. Without it, the country's own language (Finnish for FI, Norwegian for NO).

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what a vet service costs in Finland or Norway (paljonko maksaa, hva koster): the price range of a service and each clinic's price, cheapest first, optionally in one city. Without a service it lists every service's price range. Not for insurance, emergencies or the price of one free time (search_vet_slots returns that).

country.description: FI (Finland) or NO (Norway): whose clinics, times and prices. Without it, the country of the endpoint the server is connected by (vettid.fi: Finland, vettid.no: Norway).

lang.description: The language the user writes in: fi, sv, en or nb. The services' names in the answer and the labels of the view come in it. Without it, the country's own language (Finnish for FI, Norwegian for NO).
